title: Set the Mac's appearance to Light or Dark in System Settings

setup.why: Keep the Mac's own appearance and Auto setting for teardown, turn Auto off, and set the opposite of the asked appearance.

instruction: Using System Settings, set the Mac's appearance to {{mode.say}}.

checks.why: System Events' appearance preferences report dark mode as asked (true for Dark, false for Light): the Appearance choice of System Settings › Appearance.
argv: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to get dark mode

checks.why: The appearance is fixed, not Auto: the global AppleInterfaceStyleSwitchesAutomatically, which the Auto choice sets, is off or absent.

argv: if application id "com.apple.systempreferences" is running then

teardown.why: Put back the Mac's own appearance and Auto setting.

oracle.why: Set the asked appearance through System Events.

argv: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to {{mode.want}}
